reading: TV chef Nigella Lawson has been praised by critics for her new role as a judge on The Great British Bake Off, which returns to Channel 4 later this month.
Lawson is taking over from Dame Prue Leith, who expressed her departure from the series as a desire to 'work less and play more'.
The 17th series officially premieres on 22 September, though its opening episode was screened to critics earlier this week.

The Times lauded Lawson's engaging presence, stating that 'lashings of Nigella Lawson help everyone rise to the occasion,' while the Telegraph found her 'more delectable than anything the contestants could whip up in a showstopper challenge'.
The roster of contestants for the new series has also been officially confirmed, comprising a paediatric doctor, a competitive sprinter, a hairdresser, and a drag artist.

Ben Dowell of the Times specifically highlighted some of Lawson's evocative lines from the debut episode, such as her wish for a bake to be 'really sumptuous,' delivered in her 'highly seductive voice'.

Dowell further noted the production team's evident delight in having her, commenting, 'at times... it feels as if the programme is entertaining royalty,' and concluding that 'Bake Off has found a new star'.

Anita Singh of The Telegraph similarly concurred, observing that 'Nigella is heaven for social media. The woman is a walking meme factory,' underscoring her inherent appeal for generating online content.
Singh further quoted Lawson's distinctive utterances, including 'The flavours are giving me a lot of pleasure,' 'I like a bit of goo,' and 'I'm hoping to find that wonderful frisson.'
Among the latest crop of aspiring star bakers is Clara, a marketing graduate from Portugal who only started baking two years ago.
Connie, an NHS hospital discharge lead, is affectionately known as 'the cake lady' and utilises baking as a therapeutic means to unwind after demanding days.
Gabe, a 32-year-old artist and drag king, developed an early fascination with baking after watching the initial series of Bake Off at thirteen.
Moyin, a political economy student and accomplished competitive sprinter, creatively infuses his bakes with flavours inspired by his rich Nigerian heritage.
Yannis, a paediatric doctor working in a busy NICU, aspires to dismantle the misconception that Bangladeshi men do not belong in culinary spaces, often brightening his ward with his baking creations.

vocabulary.definition: To convey a thought, feeling, or intention, often in words or actions.
To have the first public showing or performance of a film, play, or television programme.
Highly praised or celebrated, often publicly and enthusiastically.
Charming and attractive in a way that captivates attention and interest.
A list of people or things, especially one showing who is available or assigned to tasks.
Consisting of or including various parts or members.
Bringing strong images, memories, or feelings vividly to mind.
Emphasizing the importance or truth of something.
Existing in something as a permanent, essential, or characteristic attribute.
To take apart a system, belief, or practice; to effectively destroy or abolish it.

entries.ja: 考え、感情、意図などを言葉や行動で伝えること。
entries.ko: 생각, 감정, 의도 등을 말이나 행동으로 전달하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 传达想法、感受或意图，通常通过言语或行动。
entries.es: Transmitir un pensamiento, sentimiento o intención, a menudo con palabras o acciones.
entries.pt-BR: Transmitir um pensamento, sentimento ou intenção, geralmente por meio de palavras ou ações.

entries.ja: 映画、演劇、テレビ番組などが初めて一般に公開されること。
entries.ko: 영화, 연극, TV 프로그램 등이 처음으로 대중에게 상영되거나 공연되는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 电影、戏剧或电视节目首次公开放映或演出。
entries.es: Tener la primera exhibición o representación pública de una película, obra de teatro o programa de televisión.
entries.pt-BR: Ter a primeira exibição ou apresentação pública de um filme, peça teatral ou programa de televisão.

entries.ja: 高く評価されたり、称賛されたりしたこと。多くの場合、公の場で熱意を込めて褒められることを指す。
entries.ko: 종종 공개적으로 열정적으로 매우 칭찬받거나 찬양받는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 受到高度赞扬或颂扬，通常是公开且充满热情的。
entries.es: Ser muy elogiado o celebrado, a menudo de forma pública y entusiasta.
entries.pt-BR: Ser muito elogiado ou celebrado, frequentemente de forma pública e entusiástica.

entries.ja: 人の注意や興味を引きつけ、魅了するような魅力的で心惹かれる様子。
entries.ko: 관심과 흥미를 사로잡을 정도로 매력적이고 유쾌한.
entries.zh-Hans: 有魅力、能吸引人的注意并激发兴趣的。
entries.es: Encantador y atractivo de una manera que cautiva la atención y el interés.
entries.pt-BR: Charmoso e atraente de uma forma que cativa a atenção e o interesse.

entries.ja: 人や物の一覧表。特に、対応できる人や仕事の担当者を示すもの。
entries.ko: 사람이나 사물의 목록으로, 특히 누가 이용 가능하거나 어떤 작업에 배정되었는지 보여주는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 人或事物的清单，尤指显示谁可用或被分配到任务的清单。
entries.es: Una lista de personas o cosas, especialmente una que muestra quién está disponible o asignado a tareas.
entries.pt-BR: Uma lista de pessoas ou coisas, especialmente uma que mostra quem está disponível ou atribuído a tarefas.

entries.ja: さまざまな部分やメンバーから成り立っている、またはそれらを含んでいること。
entries.ko: 다양한 부분이나 구성원으로 이루어져 있거나 포함하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 由各种部分或成员组成，或包括这些部分或成员。
entries.es: Consistir en, o incluir, varias partes o miembros.
entries.pt-BR: Consistir em ou incluir várias partes ou membros.

entries.ja: 強いイメージ、記憶、または感情を鮮明に思い起こさせる。
entries.ko: 강렬한 이미지, 기억 또는 감정을 생생하게 떠올리게 하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 生动地唤起强烈的形象、记忆或情感。
entries.es: Que trae a la mente vívidamente fuertes imágenes, recuerdos o sentimientos.
entries.pt-BR: Que traz à mente vividamente fortes imagens, memórias ou sentimentos.

entries.ja: 何かの重要性や真実を強調すること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것의 중요성이나 진실을 강조하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 强调某事的重要性或真实性。
entries.es: Enfatizar la importancia o la verdad de algo.
entries.pt-BR: Enfatizar a importância ou a verdade de algo.

entries.ja: 何かの永続的で本質的または特徴的な属性として存在していること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것에 영구적이고 본질적 또는 특징적인 속성으로 존재하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 作为一种永久的、本质的或特征性的属性存在于某事物之中。
entries.es: Existir en algo como un atributo permanente, esencial o característico.
entries.pt-BR: Existente em algo como um atributo permanente, essencial ou característico.

entries.ja: 仕組みや信念、慣行などを解体し、実質的に壊したり廃止したりすること。
entries.ko: 시스템, 신념, 관행 등을 해체하는 것; 효과적으로 파괴하거나 폐지하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 拆解一个系统、信仰或惯例；有效地摧毁或废除它。
entries.es: Desmantelar un sistema, creencia o práctica; destruirlo o abolirlo eficazmente.
entries.pt-BR: Desmontar um sistema, crença ou prática; destruí-lo ou aboli-lo eficazmente.

changes.before: 通过言语或行动表达思想、感受或意图。
changes.after: 传达想法、感受或意图，通常通过言语或行动。

changes.before: 公に、そして熱狂的に高く評価されたり、称賛されたりすること。
changes.after: 高く評価されたり、称賛されたりしたこと。多くの場合、公の場で熱意を込めて褒められることを指す。

changes.before: 人や物事のリストで、特に誰が利用可能か、またはどの仕事に割り当てられているかを示すもの。
changes.after: 人や物の一覧表。特に、対応できる人や仕事の担当者を示すもの。

changes.before: システム、信念、慣習などを分解すること。効果的に破壊したり廃止したりすること。
changes.after: 仕組みや信念、慣行などを解体し、実質的に壊したり廃止したりすること。

changes.before: 由各种部分或成员组成或包含。
changes.after: 由各种部分或成员组成，或包括这些部分或成员。

changes.before: 以引人入胜的方式吸引注意力和兴趣的。
changes.after: 有魅力、能吸引人的注意并激发兴趣的。
